subject: Quick favor - need your expertise
body: Hi! I know this is last minute, but could you help with something? The exec team wants a presentation on our platform architecture for tomorrow's board meeting at 9 AM. You're the only person who really understands this stuff well enough to explain it clearly. Could you put together maybe 5-6 slides covering: current architecture, scalability roadmap, competitive positioning, and cost projections? Nothing too detailed - just clear high-level insights. This could be great visibility for you with the board! Let me know if you can help - really appreciate it!
